name: @assistant-ui/react-markdown
notes: Optional markdown renderer built on react-markdown 10.1. Adds about 87 packages and ~72 KB gzip to the bundle. Raw HTML is not enabled by default. Family alternatives: react-streamdown and react-syntax-highlighter. Measured 63.2 MB install with React.

build_vs_buy.effort: 1-2 weeks with react-markdown; longer for streaming plugins
build_vs_buy.rationale: The integration is straightforward; streaming, plugin composition and sanitisation are the tail.
